children: SpaceX spending on capital expenditure on AI- which it calls SI-more than doubled to $16.4 billion. That overshadows the capex spending on its space business, which rose to $1.6 billion. Overall, cap-ex jumped to nearly $20 billion from $6.9 billion in the same period last year.
